violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (Ice Machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was disposed of. Establishment began servicing ice machine during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings in the stairwell to the basement. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment contacted pest control during time of inspection. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings and areas droppings present. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
The foundation of the building by the back kitchen door, was observed with a hole. Establishment must close hole to protect against the entry of rodents. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the milk case refrigerator. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the three bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 10/12/2026
The hot water knob on the kitchen hand sink was observed in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/12/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the milk cooler. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/1900

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2025
